method: CPC texts from the Tricoteuses LEGI mirror (state in force on the build date); successors from branch futur. Q: English gist/keywords per article (LLM). R: BM25 keyword retrieval over the FULL texts of all Missouri Rules and RSMo sections (top 8) plus the v1 candidates. M: mapping decision on FULL CPC and Missouri texts (≤3 articles, ≤18 candidates per call; texts capped at 9,000/7,000 chars). V: independent verification pass (only the article and proposed provisions): confirm/downgrade, confidence, verbatim quotes, grounded notes; quotes checked mechanically (exact after normalisation, or 'near' = ≥90% of the quote's words in order within one passage). Pruning and verified flag per scripts/mop_build.py docstring. FRCP: committee-note basis vs editorial.
